It is doing awards and AI: seven Cannes Lions in 2026, a 2026-09 HubSpot global campaign around an agentic customer platform, new Americas and marketing leaders. openings:
The strongest opening is the layer AKQA does not sell. Its record scores SEO, AI search, paid media and retail media 0 and shows no feed, schema or entity work, while its book is enterprise brands (Google, Nike, Netflix, Dior, Louis Vuitton) whose products answer engines will read. A rival bringing that machine readable layer and an audited AI visibility number is likely, at moderate confidence, to win work beside the design and product engagements without displacing them; the falsifier is a new expertise line or case study showing feed, schema or entity work.

The contestable names are the shoppers: Google, Netflix, Nike, Nestlé and Coca-Cola already buy from other tracked agencies, and the 8 names without described work are open questions. The gap to lead with is pricing: no public model, P5 unknown, and a holdco parent whose Q3 disclosures Horus watches for outcome pricing. The offer that undercuts is onshore delivery against an observed São Paulo hub with migration at 82.4, though a pure rate attack is unlikely to move a brand book with displacement at 55.4.
